x-retry-policy: Attachment confirmation enumerates the complete acknowledged turn, or complete thread without an ACK, with unique exact persisted clientId; at most 1000 pages of 10 within 8000ms. Never automatically retry mutations; operation IDs bind a request hash and its original result within a generation. Whole STATE_SNAPSHOT events may be coalesced; accept monotonically greater seq within the same generation/epoch. Read native history after generation/epoch change. activities/item are read-only scoped queries; generation rotation rejects a late result. Initial open/items/events omit non-message bodies. Summaries up to 100 IDs are fetched only on group expansion; full display on item expansion. Goal pause/clear additionally interrupt the confirmed active turn. Accepted earlier stages followed by any failure yield unknown; read open/goalGet before a new explicit operation. Native goals own automatic continuation. Plans carry native text/status; planProgress is transient and cannot be restored from history.

x-agent-results.authority: Only configured ownerId receives Result descriptors in open/items/item RPC replies. Shared live snapshots contain resultCount only.
x-agent-results.completion: Completed native agentMessage full Markdown is parsed before display truncation; started and streamed messages never bind. Native text and native media are never rewritten.
x-agent-results.recovery: Completed native history restores the same owner/project/thread/turn/item binding through artifacts output.list/output.bind. Identical repeated bindings are idempotent; deleted results retain descriptors.
x-agent-results.metadata: Read metadata uses one deadline from request admission: min(artifacts.timeoutMs, rpcTimeouts.read minus 500ms), including time spent reading native history and recovering incoming references. Both decorators use only its remainder; ordinary messages without results/candidates never query outgoing metadata. Background completion and incoming mutations keep their existing budgets. First availability failure stops remaining metadata reads; expired metadata preserves native text with unavailable state. Descriptors repeat on every native message text page; response budget exhaustion fails explicitly.

x-agent-read-state.authority: ownerId is provided by the trusted web gateway and must equal configured ownerId. Read state is private; shared STATE_SNAPSHOT events never include marks.
x-agent-read-state.operations: readState(ownerId) and readMark(ownerId,projectId,threadId,messageId,lastMessageAt) return ReadState. Keys are projectId:threadId; values contain read IDs retained under the greatest timestamp, at most 128 IDs per chat. Both commands work independently of Codex generation.
x-agent-read-state.persistence: Both agent processes share explicit config.readStatePath SQLite storage. BEGIN IMMEDIATE isolates writers, WAL permits readers, synchronous=FULL confirms durable commit. busy_timeout is 1000ms. Corrupt/unreadable files fail startup; only a missing file initializes empty state. File must be restored separately from immutable code.
x-agent-read-state.retry: readMark is idempotent and may be retried after any outcome. Older/equal timestamps merge IDs to preserve live/history clock differences; a newer timestamp for an unknown ID replaces the set. A known ID is a no-op at any timestamp. Import legacy localStorage IDs with lastMessageAt=0; live reads use thread/item lastMessageAt. Snapshot is bounded by limits.state and stored row content by 16*limits.state; overflow fails CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED before writing, without eviction.
x-agent-read-state.failure: A failure before commit is UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE/not-sent; commit failure is unknown. readState returns a coherent snapshot after previous admitted writes, or query error.
